Greeting from Maibang Degree College
       Maibang Degree college was instituted on 5th September 1988. Significantly it was brought into existence
on the birth of Dr Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan in essence of imparting value and quality education. Since then
Maibang Degree College has been working relentlessly on its mission 89Searching for Knowledge and Excellence99.
Folk of the senior citizen, educated youth led by the educationist Late Bhadreshwar Bodo pioneered the institution.
The journey of higher education at Maibang was set for the necessity of education across the hilly terrain among
the youths enrolling student of weaker sections. It enhances the role of higher education in the District of Dima
Hasao in Assam situated in an area of 112 bigha plots of land including the Botanical garden at one of the oldest
capital of the Dimasa Kingdom called Maibang.
        The office of the principal was glorified by the Late Bhadreshwar Bodo who was the first principal of the
institution. His noble guidance invigorates Maibang Degree College narrating the story of dedication and sacrifice.
He retired on 9th January 2006 and it situated Sri Dibyajoti Hazarika to officiate the administration till 5th January
2023. My tenure as principal of Maibang Degree College is enforced on 5th January 2023. It enacts me to
patronise the grandeur of the institution in pursuit of knowledge and excellence.
       Maibang Degree College was embodied by bringing in deficit-grant-in-aid system on 1st April 2001and
meanwhile provincialized on 1st December 2005. It has been ascertaining the needs and prosperity of the tribal
and non-tribal imparting the right to knowledge and information heightening the stature of education as time
passed. However, the journey of the institution was initially uneven crucifying the fact of poor infrastructure and
other allied facilities. But it becalms all hurdles amplifying pure workforce and selfless dedication of the people
and assistance of the Government of Assam, North Cachar Hills Autonomous Council and Prime Minister
Uchchatar Shiksha Abhiyan (PM-USA). The teaching fraternity justifies the process of teaching and learning
by specialization to deal with the curriculum for the General and Honours courses.
      As such Maibang Degree College is now enlarged in its scope, function and infrastructure enabling facilities
of a Library with SOUL software, Smart Classroom, Departmental Teachers9 Common Room, Conference



                                                                                     Prospectus, 2025-2026 # 1
 Room procuring technology assets, Language Lab, Science Laboratories, College Canteen, Staff Quarter, Girls9
Hostel, Boys9 Hostel, Guest House, separate Common Rooms for boys and Girls, Offices of the MDCSU, NCC
both boys and Girls, NSS and MDC Alumni. Indeed, the core aim of the institution is to benefit the students and it
is accustomed by NCC and NSS. Two building for Science Stream are already used as class rooms and another
building for Science Stream is under construction.
       Maibang Degree College has been imparting an undergraduate level of education in Arts streams. The
institution has been strengthened recently by the initiative of the Government of Assam and North Cachar Hills
Autonomous Council to introduce Science courses. Necessary steps are being taken for the appointment of teaching
and non-teaching staff. It would fertilize the yard of higher education in the district of Dima Hasao familiarizing
science education.
        Academic Year (2023 3 2024) was a glorious year for the college. It has successfully completed the 1st
Cycle of NAAC Assessment. For the preparation of the SSR of the college, the IQAC and the NAAC Steering
Committee of the college worked hard to digitalize the required data from 2017 academic session. For this team
effort, Maibang Degree College is successful in attaining the status of the single Grade B College with 2.37 CGPA
Score in the District of Dima Hasao in the 1st Cycle of NAAC Assessment.
       Maibang Degree College has been successful in fulfilling the dreams of the aspirants for Undergraduate and
Postgraduate studies through the study centre of Krishna Kanta Handique State Open University (KKHSOU)
since 2012.
      I am committed to work on the mission and vision of the college which is to foster students, teachers and the
wider community with the proper knowledge to cope with the rapid technological changes in teaching and learning
through effective communication in multicultural and multilingual settings.



Date: 05-05-2025                                                                   SUJIT KUMAR SINHA

2 # Prospectus, 2025-2026
        It gives me immense pleasure to share my gratitude to the faculty members of the college on selecting me
as the Coordinator of IQAC & NAAC Steering Commitee of the college in its general meeting on 6th January,
2023. I feel highly honoured to take the responsibility.
       Before my joining the additional responsibility as the IQAC Coordinator, the College authority had already
submitted the Institutional Information for Quality Assessment (IIQA) for the 1st cycle of NAAC Assessment of
the institution on the 29th December, 2022. Therefore, immediately after taking the chair of the coordinator I had to
respond to the series of queries to the IIQA and finally IIQA was approved on the 6th March, 2023.
       The next task was the preparation of the Self Study Report (SSR) of the institution. With the full cooperation
of the former Principal i/c Sri Dibyajyoti Hazarika, the Present Principal i/c Sri Sujit Kumar Sinha and Joint
Coordinator of NAAC Steering Commitee, Sri Pranjit Sarma and the Criterion Conveners of the NAAC Steering
Committee the preparation works for the SSR was completed within the stipulated time of 45 days of IIQA
approval. The preparation of the SSR was really very difficult task as most of the data required were not
systematically stored, processed and digitalized for the entire period of assessment. The Principal i/c, myself and
Pranjit Sarma worked day and night for the preparation of the SSR. The stage of Data Validation and Verification
(DVV) of the assessment process was also completed by responding to a total of 37 numbers DVV clarifications
sought by the NAAC authority. The SSR was finally approved on 22nd June, 2023 and The Peer Team Visit dates
were fixed on 17th and 18th October, 2023. We, the team started working for welcoming the Peer Team by bringing
awareness among the stake holders of the college about the Peer Team visit and preparing the presentation before
the Peer Team. We got the result of the assessment on 27th October. NAAC has accredited Grade B to our college
with CGPA score of 2.37.
       From taking charge of the Coordinator of IQAC amidst lots of works of IIQA clarifications, SSR preparation,
DVV clarifications and Preparation for the Peer Team Visit, the IQAC could not do much to the expectations of
an institution of higher education. However, during the last academic year, the IQAC of the college took up the
following initiatives for the enhancement of the quality education:
      The IQAC has introduced mentoring for the students. In its initiative syllabus for 03 numbers of Add on
Courses have been framed and approved by the Governing Body. Among others signing of MoU with Lumding
College, monitoring the free admission to the BPL students, preparing the academic calendar and class routine,

                                                                                   Prospectus, 2025-2026 # 3
 looking into the infrastructural development, outreach programmes of the faculties, helping the college authority in
the processes of admission and the maintenance of the server of the college, Samarth e-govt suit, etc. are of worth
mention.
       Most of our students hail from socially and economically deprived sections and from the remote tribal
villages. Therefore, to develop self confidence levels, IQAC with the help of support services has started providing
Academic Counseling, Career Counseling, Induction Programme to the newly admitted students, Health awareness
programs, Health check-up camps, intimate mentor - mentee relationship etc.
       With the implementation of NEP 2020 from the Academic Year 2023-2024, the students have got the opportunity
to study diverse subjects through the NEP curriculum of Assam University, Silchar. However, the shortage of
classrooms in the college will have to be met by the Government Authorities and with the full coverage of the 8th
semesters there will be shortage of teachers also. Hope the stake holders of the college will be successful in
overcoming the challenges of imparting quality education the college may face in the coming days.
      My best wishes to the new comers for happy learning experiences at Maibang Degree College.


                                                                                                 Dr Dadul Borah

Honours Courses). The course is affiliated to Assam University, Silchar and is governed by the rules and regulations

on successful completion of Six/Eight semesters having passed in Six/Eight End semester examinations conducted
by Assam University.

ADMISSION PROCEDURE
1.    Admission to the College is through online process only in the prescribed Application Form available in the
      website of Samarthhttps://assamadmission.samarth.ac.in/ and in the College Website https://
      maibangdegreecollege.edu.in The candidates have to compulsorily apply in both the websites.
2.    Notice prescribing the last date of Admission is hung up in the college notice board and college website
      usually a few days before or after the declaration of the result of the qualifying examination.
3.    The Admission Form must be filled in completely in all respects and the hard copy of the Application must be
      submitted with the supporting documents. Incomplete Form(s) will be rejected straightway.
4.    Admission process is conducted under the direct control of the Admission committee. In case of admission
      to the 8Honours Course, the rules of Assam University and the decision of the concerned department will be
      binding.
5.    Admission is strictly on merit and is governed by the admission rules framed by the ADMISSION Committee.
      The decision of the chairperson of the admission Committee stands final.
6.    Any under pressure or interference in the matter (s) of admission will be treated as disqualification.
7.    The self-attested copies of the following documents (two Copies each) are to be furnished along with the
      hardcopy Application Form:
       " Mark Sheet, Certificate, Admit Card and Registration Card of HSLC<HS and other qualifying
         examinations.
       " Character Certificate.
       " SC/ST/OB/MOBC Certificate.
       " Permanent Residential Certificate.
       " Gap certificate from appropriate authority in case the student who passed the qualifying examination
         earlier than the current year.
       " Original Migration/Transfer Certificate for the students seeking admission other than in the 1st Semester.
       " Latest passport size photograph. (4 copies)
8.    The original copies of the attested documents must be produced before the Admission Committee.
9.    Presence of the Candidate on the date of interview/admission before the Admission Committee is compulsory.
10.   The fees (if there be any) for admission must be paid on the date of admission after the approval from the
      Admission Committee.
11.   No request for admission will be entertained after the prescribed date(s) fixed by the authorities concerned.
12.   There is reservation of seats for the student belonging to SC, ST (P), ST (H), OBC (including MOBC) and
      physically Handicapped (PH) categories as per Government rules. Valid certificate issued by the competent
      authority must be produced in original before the Admission Committee on the date of admission and the
      Xerox Copy must be attached with the Application Forms. The reservation of seats is as follows:
          *SC-7%
          *STP- 10%
          *STH- 5%

SCHOLARSHIP, AID FUNDS AND AWARDS
    l SCHOLARSHIPS : Students are entitled to apply for National Scholarship, State Merit Scholarship,SC/
       ST/OBC/MOBC Scholarships as and when notified.
    l Aid Funds : The college has a fund known as Students9 Aid Fund. This has been constituted to provide
       financial assistance to the poor and meritorious students of the college. On application to the Principal with
       supporting documents, the Academic Committee will take all aspects in to considerations and determines the
       quantum of aid to the suitable candidate (s) to enable him/her/them to fill up examination forms or purchase
       of books.
    l Awards : The college plans to felicitate the students of all departments securing First Class or FirstDivision
       in TDC Final examination which include a felicitation certificate, a packet of gift and cash money which
       is decided by the Academic Committee.
WORKSHOPS/SEMINARS/LECTURE PROGRAMME ETC.
       The college organizes workshops, seminars, lecture programmes, awareness programmes on health, education,
culture & traditions and environment regularly in collaboration with different organizations and associations. All
modern facilities for conducting such programmes are available in the college.
EXTRA CURRICULARAMENITIES
Ø      STUDENTS BODY OF THE COLLEGE
       MDCSU (Maibang Degree College Students9 Union) is the students body in the college. The students body
       has its own constitution. All office bearers are directly elected/ selected by the students from among them
       for a term of one year. MDCSU organizes various co-curricular activities from time to time. The most
       important event organized by it is the <Annual College week= which generally is held after the odd Semester
       Examination. Moreover, MDCSU organizes Fresher9s Social, Foundation Day of the college cum Teachers9
       day on 5thSeptember, Saraswati puja and some other important events each year. MDCSU is having its own
       office room for the office bearers.
Ø      Alumni Office
       The Alumni Office is constructed near the College Canteen during the last Academic Year.
Ø      NCC

       girls. The NCC is an organization which provides a golden opportunity for cadets to developed leadership
       qualities, self confidence, to be disciplined and devoted citizen to promote the cause of National Integration
       and Nation Building. The college is having a separate office for NCC.
       For details. the interested students of college may contact the Professors-in- Charge of NCC for both boys
       and girls separately. The CTO of NCC (boys) is Shri Ankur Kumar Das and the CTO of NCC (girls) is
       Rajashree Nunisa.
Ø      NSS

GENERAL RULES FOR MAINTANCE OF DISCIPLINE THE COLLEGE
1.   The college lays great emphasis on discipline and character building of the students. The rules and the
     regulations of the college are binding to all students of the college.
2.   Only such individuals, societies or Association as have been recognised/approved by the Principal, shall
     have the facilities to the College premises.
3.   At the time of admission, the students and the parents/ guardians are required to furnished an undertaking in
     respect of the student9 regular attendance in the class and appearance in the college and university examination
     as per guidelines/ instructions as specified by the concerned authorities.
4.   The rules concerning the attendance in the class of the students are strictly maintained in accordance to the
     instruction of Assam University, Silchar which is notified by the college authority at the beginning of the
     academic session. The rules for non-collegiate and dis-collegiate will be strictly adhered to.
5.   The rules concerning college examination are strictly accorded to the Examination Committee of the college.
     And for the university examinations the eligibility conditions and instructions of the university will be strictly
     followed.
6.   The following activities of the students in this college will be treated as serious offences. All powers for
     disciplinary actions against the offences are vested with the Principal and the Academic Committee of the
     College and their decision shall be final in all such matters.
     I.      Encouraging and participating in ragging of any types.
     II.     Forcible disruption of class.
     III.    Destruction of college properties.
     IV.     Misbehaviour shown towards girls, women, teachers and employees of the college.

7.   Students are to keep the photo-identity card of the college with them in the college premises and
     they may have to produce it on demand. The identity cards shall be made available to the students within 15
     days from the date of admission. The identity Cards are to be renewed in each academic year. The old
     identity cards are to be submitted for renewal at the beginning of the new academic year. Loss of identity
     card must be reported to the college office immediately and applied for a duplicate one with proper
     documentation and cost.
8.   College uniform for the students is a must while they are in the college campus during routine hours (excepts
     for NCC/NSS/cultural/ sports practices/ activities)

     the college is strictly prohibited.
